messages.author: 974ea51749a9e704
messages.subject: Shiny - ODBC and SSL
parts:
Hi,

1/ I setup a shiny server on Ubuntu and works fine.
2/ Then I set up an ODBC connection to a MySQL database that is located on a different server. After some search and work I succeeded both inside the R command line and inside Shiny.
  - I used RODBC and odbcUNIX connector
3/ Then I wanted to make the ODBC connection encrypted and again it worked inside R on my Ubuntu server.
 - for this set I just added sslca = mycertificate.pem inside the odbc.ini file for my connection
4/ When I try to run Shiny it does not work. I got:
Warning in odbcDriverConnect("DSN=MyConnection") :
[RODBC] ERROR: state HY000, code 2026, message [unixODBC][MySQL][ODBC 5.1 Driver]SSL connection error: ASN: bad other signature confirmation
Warning in odbcDriverConnect("DSN=MyConnection") : ODBC connection failed

Any idea? Do you know if this is possible to have ODBC and SSL inside Shiny?

Stéphane

messages.author: 974ea51749a9e704
messages.subject: Re: Shiny - ODBC and SSL
parts:
The problem seems to be a permission issue.
If the certificate file is placed inside the /etc/ssl/certs directory, the SSL connection works.
